description: A medical staff services director must decide whether to grant temporary privileges to a visiting electrophysiologist for a scheduled procedure and finalize the permitted scope, liability coverage, room readiness, and consent-support plan, with input from cardiology, risk management, procedural scheduling, and patient relations.

shared_context.S1: A visiting electrophysiologist has been asked to perform one scheduled electrophysiology procedure at the hospital on May 14.
shared_context.S2: Marisol makes the final decision on temporary clinical privileges.
shared_context.S3: Hospital policy requires temporary privileges to specify the clinical scope, the applicable date, and any operational conditions before the clinician may begin work.
shared_context.S4: Before making the call, Marisol follows the routine verification step of checking with cardiology, risk management, procedural scheduling, and patient relations.

PF1.text: The visiting physician's board certification and reference review support temporary privileges only for intracardiac electrophysiology study and catheter ablation; the approved privilege date is May 14, and Dr. Chen has the signed specialty review packet.

PF2.text: The physician's malpractice carrier issued an endorsement covering exactly two electrophysiology procedures at this hospital on May 14, so the privilege record must state coverage as two procedures on that date rather than unrestricted visiting coverage.

PF3.text: The electrophysiology laboratory and anesthesia team are reserved from 13:00 to 16:00 on May 14, and the reservation will be released unless the temporary-privilege approval is entered before 12:00 that day.

PF4.text: The patient has requested Spanish-language consent support, and a certified Spanish interpreter is booked for 12:30 on May 14; patient relations requires that interpreter attendance be recorded before the procedure begins.

acceptance_conditions: Temporary privileges must be approved for the visiting physician.
The approved clinical scope must be exactly intracardiac electrophysiology study and catheter ablation.
The privilege date must be exactly May 14.
The liability record must state coverage for exactly two procedures on May 14.
A commitment must record that the electrophysiology laboratory and anesthesia team are held from 13:00 to 16:00 on May 14.
A commitment must record certified Spanish interpreter attendance at 12:30 on May 14.
The cardiology review supporting the privilege scope must be spoken aloud, credited, and cited by the decision-maker.

content_checks.C2: ('intracardiac electrophysiology study' in decisions.get('clinical_scope') or 'Intracardiac electrophysiology study' in decisions.get('clinical_scope')) and ('catheter ablation' in decisions.get('clinical_scope') or 'Catheter ablation' in decisions.get('clinical_scope'))
content_checks.C4: (('two' in decisions.get('liability_coverage') or 'Two' in decisions.get('liability_coverage')) and ('electrophysiology procedures' in decisions.get('liability_coverage') or 'Electrophysiology procedures' in decisions.get('liability_coverage')) and 'May 14' in decisions.get('liability_coverage'))
content_checks.C5: any((('13:00 to 16:00' in c['detail'] or '13:00–16:00' in c['detail'] or '13:00-16:00' in c['detail']) and 'May 14' in c['detail'] and (('laboratory' in c['detail'] or 'laboratory' in c['detail']) or ('lab' in c['detail'] or 'Lab' in c['detail'])) and ('anesthesia' in c['detail'] or 'Anesthesia' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(('Spanish' in c['detail'] and 'interpreter' in c['detail'] and '12:30' in c['detail'] and 'May 14' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The cardiology review changes the decision from an unsupported approval to approval limited to intracardiac electrophysiology study and catheter ablation on May 14, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
The insurance endorsement changes the liability entry from unspecified or unrestricted coverage to exactly two procedures on May 14.
The scheduling reservation changes the operational plan from no room commitment to a hold for the electrophysiology laboratory and anesthesia team from 13:00 to 16:00 on May 14.
The patient-relations arrangement changes the consent plan from no specified language support to certified Spanish interpreter attendance at 12:30 on May 14.
